nodes.description: PlayTimeProfit.uniswapV2Router: DEX router used for token-to-ETH swaps and liquidity
PlayTimeProfit.dividendTracker: PTPDividendTracker instance that holds and distributes ETH dividends
PlayTimeProfit.swapping: boolean lock flag used during the fee-swap routine
PlayTimeProfit.liquidityWallet: wallet receiving liquidity ETH and exempt from fees
Ownable._owner: privileged owner address controlling onlyOwner functions
DividendPayingToken.magnifiedDividendPerShare: magnified dividends per token share
DividendPayingToken.magnifiedDividendCorrections: per-account dividend correction term
DividendPayingToken.withdrawnDividends: ETH already withdrawn per account
PTPDividendTracker.excludedFromDividends: accounts excluded from dividend distribution
PTPDividendTracker.lastClaimTimes: last claim timestamp per account
PTPDividendTracker.lastProcessedIndex: cursor of the dividend gas-processing loop
PlayTimeProfit.gasForProcessing: gas forwarded to dividend auto-claim processing
PlayTimeProfit._isExcludedFromFees: accounts exempt from transfer fees
PlayTimeProfit.automatedMarketMakerPairs: whitelist of AMM pair addresses
ERC20._balances: token balance mapping
ReentrancyGuard._status: nonReentrant lock status variable
PTPDividendTracker.claimWait: minimum seconds between dividend claims
PlayTimeProfit.uniswapV2Pair: immutable AMM pair address of the token
PlayTimeProfit._transfer: fee-taking transfer that swaps tokens for ETH, pays owner, funds dividends and processes claims
PlayTimeProfit.swapAndSendToOwner: swaps tokens for ETH and forwards the proceeds to owner via low-level call
PlayTimeProfit.swapTokensForEth: approves and swaps tokens for ETH on the router with block.timestamp deadline
PlayTimeProfit.swapAndSendDividends: swaps tokens for ETH and forwards balance to the dividend tracker via low-level call
PlayTimeProfit.processDividendTracker: external permissionless call to dividendTracker.process emitting tx.origin
PlayTimeProfit.claim: external function claiming dividends for msg.sender
PlayTimeProfit.updateDividendTracker: onlyOwner replacement of the dividend tracker contract
PlayTimeProfit.setAutomatedMarketMakerPair: onlyOwner update of AMM pair whitelist and dividend exclusion
PTPDividendTracker.processAccount: onlyOwner withdrawal of dividends for an account and timestamp recording
PTPDividendTracker.process: gas-bounded loop over holders auto-claiming dividends
PTPDividendTracker.canAutoClaim: timestamp based eligibility check for auto claiming
PTPDividendTracker.setBalance: onlyOwner balance synchronisation and claim processing
PTPDividendTracker.excludeFromDividends: onlyOwner removal of an account from dividend tracking
DividendPayingToken._withdrawDividendOfUser: state update followed by a low-level ETH call to the user
DividendPayingToken.distributeDividends: payable entry distributing msg.value as magnified dividends
DividendPayingToken.accumulativeDividendOf: view computing total earned dividends from shares and corrections
DividendPayingToken._setBalance: internal mint/burn synchronisation of tracked balances
ERC20.transferFrom: allowance based transfer decrementing the allowance
ERC20._transfer: internal balance moving function with zero-address checks
Ownable.transferOwnership: onlyOwner ownership transfer
Ownable.renounceOwnership: onlyOwner renouncement of ownership
DividendPayingToken.receive: fallback that redistributes any received ETH via distributeDividends
PlayTimeProfit.receive: empty payable fallback accepting ETH
msg.sender: attacker controlled caller address
block.timestamp: miner influenceable time source
tx.origin: original externally owned account of the transaction

withdrawDividend() forwards msg.sender as the payable user receiving ETH
ERC20 transfers route the caller through _msgSender() into _transfer

swapTokensForEth uses block.timestamp as the router swap deadline
processDividendTracker emits tx.origin as the processor identity
_transfer emits tx.origin inside ProcessedDividendTracker event
fees is derived from the user supplied amount via mul/div arithmetic
_transfer reads and writes the swapping lock flag
_transfer checks automatedMarketMakerPairs to decide sell fees and swap eligibility
_transfer consults _isExcludedFromFees to disable fees
_transfer interacts with the dividendTracker contract instance
_transfer reads gasForProcessing to bound dividend processing
gasForProcessing value is copied into the local gas variable
newBalance is computed from the contract balance delta after the swap
swapAndSendToOwner resolves the recipient via owner()
newBalance flows into the low-level ETH call to the owner address
swapTokensForEth targets uniswapV2Router and its WETH getter
swap call parameters flow into the external router swap invocation
swapAndSendDividends targets the dividendTracker address
the whole contract ETH balance is forwarded to the dividend tracker via low-level call
address(this).balance is captured in the local dividends variable
onlyOwner assigns a new address into the dividendTracker state variable
onlyOwner writes the new pair flag into automatedMarketMakerPairs
the immutable uniswapV2Pair value guards removal of the main pair
processAccount writes the claim timestamp into lastClaimTimes
process reads and finally updates lastProcessedIndex
process reads lastClaimTimes entries and iterates indexes arithmetically
the gas measurement loop assigns newGasLeft
canAutoClaim compares elapsed time against claimWait
setBalance checks excludedFromDividends before syncing balances
excludeFromDividends sets the excludedFromDividends flag for the account
withdrawnDividends is updated before the ETH transfer to the user
_withdrawDividendOfUser calls withdrawableDividendOf which reads accumulativeDividendOf
the withdrawable amount is stored in the local _withdrawableDividend
_withdrawableDividend is sent to the user through a low-level call
distributeDividends increases magnifiedDividendPerShare based on msg.value
msg.value is scaled by magnitude and divided by totalSupply inside the update
accumulativeDividendOf multiplies magnifiedDividendPerShare by the holder balance
accumulativeDividendOf adds the per-account magnified correction term
accumulativeDividendOf reads balanceOf(account) from the balances mapping
_setBalance mints or burns to match the target balance
ERC20._transfer writes sender and recipient entries in _balances
transferOwnership is onlyOwner and writes the new owner address
renounceOwnership is onlyOwner and clears the owner address
the user parameter is the call target of the ETH transfer
receive() immediately invokes distributeDividends whenever ETH arrives
_transfer calls swapAndSendToOwner during the fee swap branch
_transfer calls swapAndSendDividends with the remaining contract balance
_transfer tries to sync balances through dividendTracker.setBalance
_transfer calls dividendTracker.process when not swapping
the setBalance and process calls are wrapped in try/catch that swallows errors
swapAndSendToOwner calls swapTokensForEth to obtain ETH
swapAndSendDividends calls swapTokensForEth before forwarding ETH
processDividendTracker forwards the gas parameter to dividendTracker.process
claim() calls processAccount for msg.sender
processAccount calls _withdrawDividendOfUser which performs the ETH transfer
process calls canAutoClaim to decide whether to process an account
process calls processAccount for eligible holders
setBalance calls _setBalance to mint or burn tracker tokens
setBalance ends by calling processAccount(account, true)
excludeFromDividends calls _setBalance(account, 0)
_setBalance reaches ERC20._transfer/_mint/_burn balance machinery
ERC20.transferFrom calls _transfer after checking the allowance
ETH sent to the dividend tracker address triggers its receive fallback and dividend distribution
the gas limited ETH call to the user can re-enter the withdrawal path during the transfer
the low-level ETH call to the owner address can re-enter the token contract through its receive fallback
the router swap pulls tokens and calls back into the token transfer logic through the pair
